verdict.rationale: There is no documented data-export or offboarding feature. The Console API offers programmatic CRUD access to everything in the console, which could be used to pull configs out. Warehouse Native runs analysis in your own data warehouse, so in that mode the data already lives in infrastructure you control. Both are indirect routes to leaving rather than a stated export capability. Missing for 10: an explicit bulk export of all data (events, exposures, configs, experiment results), documented open export formats, a migration or offboarding guide, and independent corroboration.
